        for r in resources:

        # mild preference for staying near allies to consolidate

            ax, ay = a.get("x", 0), a.get("y", 0)
            dist = abs(ax - nx) + abs(ay - ny)
            if dist <= 2:
                score += 1
        if score > best_score:
            best_score = score
            best_dx, best_dy = dx, dy

    # Try all 9 possibilities (including staying)
    for dx in (-1, 0, 1):

    # If no move found (extreme edge cases), default to staying

    return [best_dx, best_dy]
